newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia plans A$10 mln aid for steel city -paper.
newsitem.headline: Australia plans A$10 mln aid for steel city -paper.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard will unveil a A$10 million aid package to help the city of Newcastle recover from the closure of its steel plant when he visits on Wednesday, The Australian newspaper said.

The newspaper did not give details, but local community leaders want the package to provide incentives for new industries to set up in their east coast city to help replace some of the 2,500 jobs lost in the closure.
The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, Australia's largest company, plans to end steelmaking in the city, north of Sydney, in 1999.
The New South Wales state government has already announced its own A$10 million assistance package for the city and the national government had been widely expected to match that move.
Howard will visit the city today, for talks with union and community leaders, BHP officials and a tour of the steel plant.
